facts.text: Dude, the history report is due. Grab a booth and order the fries, we can figure out Napoleon after.
facts.why: Invented line signed Ted Logan. In the film Ted says 'Dude, we gotta pass; otherwise, there's no more band.' when they talk about the report and military school.
facts.fix: Dude, we gotta pass; otherwise, there's no more band.

facts.text: The history class field trip to the San Dimas mall
facts.why: There is no history class field trip. Bill and Ted leave the historical figures at the San Dimas mall to learn about the town while they look for Napoleon.
facts.fix: Where Bill and Ted park the historical figures to learn about San Dimas
